entries.title: Psalms 147:10
segments: 10, 11. The advantages afforded, as in war by the strength of the horse or the agility of man, do not incline God to favor any; but those who fear and, of course, trust Him, will obtain His approbation and aid.

entries.title: Psalms 147:15
segments: 15-18. God's Word, as a swift messenger, executes His purpose, for with Him to command is to perform (
), and He brings about the wonders of providence as easily as men cast crumbs.

entries.title: Psalms 147:19
segments: 19, 20. This mighty ruler and benefactor of heaven and earth is such especially to His chosen people, to whom alone (
) He has made known His will, while others have been left in darkness. Therefore unite in the great hallelujah.
